dedupe_keys.name: ctu fixed broadband coverage of czechia by nga 30 mbit s and 100 mbit s infrastructure per basic settlement unit

description: These ČTÚ datasets map where infrastructure can deliver fixed internet access at 30 Mbit/s or more (next-generation access, NGA) and at 100 Mbit/s or more across Czechia, for each basic settlement unit (základní sídelní jednotka, ZSJ), the smallest statistical area of the Czech statistical office, and aggregated by region by share of units covered. The NGA series has yearly files from 2014 onwards (about 2.2 MB of CSV per year), and the 100 Mbit/s series has yearly files for 2023, 2024 and 2025; companion datasets give regional summaries, NGA connections by region, and settlement units without households. Figures come from the geographic data collections that operators report to ČTÚ. Coverage: all of Czechia. Format and access: CSV and XLSX files on the ČTÚ open data catalogue, free under ČTÚ terms allowing commercial reuse with attribution. Caveats: coverage means infrastructure capable of the speed within the unit, not take-up or measured speed; units vary widely in size. Simulation uses: mapping which settlement areas depend on fixed broadband of each speed class, estimating households exposed when access networks fail, and identifying areas without redundancy. Related records: the ČTÚ open data catalogue lists the companion datasets, and the German and Austrian broadband atlases are neighbouring equivalents.
